text:
Kokua Kaua'i Donation Drive scheduled for Sept. 26-27 in Kahului
U. N. Kim
Residents and visitors are encouraged to support the Kauaʻi community following Hurricane Lowell by participating in the Kōkua Kauaʻi Donation Drive, which will be held from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. on Saturday and Sunday, Sept. 26 and 27, in Kahului, according to a Sept. 16 announcement from the County of Maui Office of the Mayor.
Mayor Richard Bissen said, “Disasters can come at any time, and when our neighbors need help, we show up for one another. Kauaʻi stood with Maui in our time of need, and now it is our turn to stand with Kauaʻi. The timing of these recent disasters does not lessen our responsibility to care for one another. This is another opportunity for our Maui community to come together, share what we can and send our aloha across the ocean channel to our neighbors on Kauaʻi.”
The donation drive will take place at the Queen Kaʻahumanu Center parking lot near the former Sears location at 275 W. Kaʻahumanu Ave.
Specific requested items include nonperishable foods such as bottled water; rice; canned foods including meats like tuna, chicken, Spam, Vienna sausage and corned beef; canned meals like chili or stew; canned fruits and vegetables; instant noodles; peanut butter; crackers; cereal; oatmeal; meal-replacement drinks such as Ensure or protein drinks; and shelf-stable milk. Other essentials requested are baby food and formula, diapers and wipes, pet food and supplies, toiletries and hygiene products, tarps, chainsaw chains of all sizes, batteries, solar or battery-powered lights, as well as cell phone charging cords and power banks.
All donated items must be new—perishable foods or clothing cannot be accepted—and will be distributed by nonprofit Hawaiʻi Food Bank Kauaʻi to communities impacted by Hurricane Lowell on Kauaʻi. Shipments will be sent via container with assistance from the International Longshore and Warehouse Union.
For more information about donations or logistics related to this event, contact County Office of the Mayor Public Affairs section at [email protected] or call (808) 270-7855.
